---
name: portfolio-review
description: Review the portfolio and identify the highest-value improvements without editing.
---

Review the current portfolio as a senior web engineer and SAP recruiter. Inspect the repository first. Identify the highest-value improvements across content, UX, responsive behavior, accessibility, performance, security, and recruiter readability. Do not edit files. Separate findings into Critical, Needs Attention, and Improvement, and explain why each matters.
